sql: SELECT `p`.`name_` AS `项目名称`, `p`.`phase_` AS `当前阶段`, `p`.`planned_progress_` AS `计划进度`, `p`.`progress_` AS `实际进度`, `p`.`light_description_` AS `亮灯原因` FROM `pp_project` AS `p` WHERE COALESCE(`p`.`deleted_`, 'N') <> 'Y' AND `p`.`light_description_` LIKE '%红灯%' ORDER BY `p`.`id_` DESC LIMIT 200

question: 每个项目的预算和实际成本对比
sql: SELECT `p`.`name_` AS `项目名称`, `p`.`total_budget_` AS `预算`, COALESCE(SUM(`c`.`amount_`), 0) AS `实际成本`, (`p`.`total_budget_` - COALESCE(SUM(`c`.`amount_`), 0)) AS `结余`, CASE WHEN `p`.`total_budget_` > 0 THEN ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(`c`.`amount_`), 0) / `p`.`total_budget_` * 100, 1) ELSE NULL END AS `预算执行率%` FROM `pp_project` AS `p` LEFT JOIN `pp_project_cost` AS `c` ON `c`.`project_id_` = `p`.`id_` AND COALESCE(`c`.`deleted_`, 'N') <> 'Y' WHERE COALESCE(`p`.`deleted_`, 'N') <> 'Y' GROUP BY `p`.`id_`, `p`.`name_`, `p`.`total_budget_` ORDER BY `实际成本` DESC LIMIT 200

question: 每个成员的任务负载
sql: SELECT `e`.`name_` AS `成员`, COUNT(DISTINCT `t`.`id_`) AS `任务数`, SUM(CASE WHEN `t`.`progress_` >= 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `已完成`, SUM(CASE WHEN `t`.`progress_` < 100 AND NOT `t`.`finish_` IS NULL AND `t`.`finish_` < NOW() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `已逾期` FROM `pp_task` AS `t` JOIN `iform_party_employee` AS `e` ON FIND_IN_SET(`e`.`id_`, `t`.`assignee_ids_`) WHERE COALESCE(`t`.`deleted_`, 'N') <> 'Y' GROUP BY `e`.`id_`, `e`.`name_` ORDER BY `任务数` DESC LIMIT 200

question: 里程碑达成情况
sql: SELECT `p`.`name_` AS `项目名称`, `t`.`name_` AS `里程碑`, `t`.`finish_` AS `计划完成`, `t`.`progress_` AS `进度`, CASE WHEN `t`.`progress_` >= 100 THEN '已完成' WHEN NOT `t`.`finish_` IS NULL AND `t`.`finish_` < NOW() THEN '已逾期' WHEN `t`.`finish_` IS NULL THEN '未排期' ELSE '进行中' END AS `达成状态` FROM `pp_task` AS `t` LEFT JOIN `pp_project` AS `p` ON `p`.`id_` = `t`.`project_id_` WHERE COALESCE(`t`.`deleted_`, 'N') <> 'Y' AND `t`.`is_milestone_` = 'Y' ORDER BY `p`.`id_` DESC, `t`.`finish_` LIMIT 200

question: 项目健康度一页纸
sql: SELECT `p`.`name_` AS `项目名称`, `p`.`planned_progress_` AS `计划进度`, `p`.`progress_` AS `实际进度`, (`p`.`progress_` - `p`.`planned_progress_`) AS `进度偏差`, CASE WHEN `p`.`light_description_` LIKE '%红灯%' THEN '红' WHEN `p`.`light_description_` LIKE '%黄灯%' THEN '黄' WHEN `p`.`light_description_` LIKE '%绿灯%' THEN '绿' ELSE '—' END AS `灯`, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `pp_task` AS `t` WHERE `t`.`project_id_` = `p`.`id_` AND COALESCE(`t`.`deleted_`, 'N') <> 'Y') AS `任务数`, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `pp_task` AS `t` WHERE `t`.`project_id_` = `p`.`id_` AND COALESCE(`t`.`deleted_`, 'N') <> 'Y' AND `t`.`progress_` < 100 AND NOT `t`.`finish_` IS NULL AND `t`.`finish_` < NOW()) AS `逾期任务`, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `pp_risk` AS `r` WHERE `r`.`project_id_` = `p`.`id_` AND COALESCE(`r`.`deleted_`, 'N') <> 'Y' AND `r`.`rating_` = 'High' AND COALESCE(`r`.`state_`, '') <> 'closed') AS `高风险未关闭`, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `pp_issue` AS `i` WHERE `i`.`project_id_` = `p`.`id_` AND COALESCE(`i`.`deleted_`, 'N') <> 'Y' AND COALESCE(`i`.`status_`, '') <> 'pass') AS `未关闭问题`, `p`.`total_budget_` AS `预算`, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(`c`.`amount_`), 0) FROM `pp_project_cost` AS `c` WHERE `c`.`project_id_` = `p`.`id_` AND COALESCE(`c`.`deleted_`, 'N') <> 'Y') AS `实际成本` FROM `pp_project` AS `p` WHERE COALESCE(`p`.`deleted_`, 'N') <> 'Y' ORDER BY `进度偏差` ASC, `p`.`id_` DESC LIMIT 200

question: 合同台账
